name: relay
description: When the context gets large, Claude writes a handoff at the end of the task. After /clear, the fresh session asks whether to pick it up.

threshold_tokens.title: Threshold (tokens)
threshold_tokens.description: Context size at which Claude writes a handoff at the end of a turn. 0 disables relay.

on_new_session.title: On new session
on_new_session.description: After /clear or startup: ask whether to pick up the handoff, load it automatically, or do nothing.

on_decline.title: If you keep going
on_decline.description: If you continue in the same session instead of /clear: stay quiet (ignore) or write a fresh handoff later (remind).

remind_every_tokens.title: Remind every (tokens)
remind_every_tokens.description: With 'remind': how much the context must grow before the next handoff.

max_age_hours.title: Max handoff age (hours)
max_age_hours.description: Older handoffs are not offered in a new session (still available via /relay:resume).
